notes.title: Tribloos 3 coming to Steam on July 16th 2018!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Thanks to everyone who has enjoyed playing Tribloos 2 for the last few years.

It's taken some time but Tribloos 3 is now due for release on the 16th of July 2018 here on Steam.

Its been on BigFishGames for the last few weeks and has received some good feedback there. So now I'm excited to hear everyone's feeedback here.

Check out the store page here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/520540/Tribloos_3/

Let me know if you have any questions :)

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards Now Available!
notes.notes:
Tribloos 2 now has Steam Trading Cards! Collect cards of all your favourite Tribloos characters! Gain badges, emoticons and wallpapers of the characters and locations in the game.

Thanks to everyone who has support Tribloos 2, we hope you enjoy the new cards.

notes.title: Tribloos 2 released!
notes.notes:
Very excited to see The Tribloos 2 get released today.

It's a game we're immensly proud of and we think you'll all enjoy it.

Let us know how you find the game and, of course, if you encounter any problems.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Tribloos 2
notes.notes:
Tribloos 2 is Now Available on Steam!

Trey's village is under threat once more. Before there was only one storm to worry about, now there have been many and Matilda the dragon is being tired out trying to blow them all away!
